crossRefs.note: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

translations.web: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
translations.bsb: And if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
translations.kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
translations.asv: But if what I would not, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwelleth in me.
